title: Donald Trump's New AI Photo Includes Tombstone Labeled 'Buried By Biden' - NewsBreak
text:
By Ishita Verma ,
44 minutes ago Photo by Chip Somodevilla/Getty Images Donald Trump recently shared a new AI photo on Truth Social, taking a jab at his predecessor, Joe Biden. The President is known for sharing multiple AI-generated photos on the platform that depict him in different scenarios. Previously, Trump posted an AI video that showcased him giving George Washington a tour of the White House ballroom.
Donald Trump shares new AI photo with Joe Biden detail Donald Trump recently posted a new AI image on Truth Social referencing Joe Biden and the Keystone pipeline project.
The image depicts Trump pulling the Keystone pipeline out of the ground, where a tombstone is shown with the words “Buried by Biden” written on it. Another banner in the photo reads, “Keystone Pipeline. Completely Free. Energy, Jobs. America First.”
Trump made this post after announcing that the United States has decided to pause the 50 percent tariffs against Canada. He further hinted that the new deal might mean reviving the Keystone Pipeline project, which Biden shut down in January 2021. He wrote in a post on Truth Social , “I have paused the 50% Tariffs against Canada, that were scheduled to kick in tomorrow morning for a three day period, based on the fact that Canada and the U.S.A., subject to the finalization of documents, have a DEAL! The great Keystone XL Pipeline, long ago killed by Sleepy Joe Biden, may be awoken from the grave!”
The Keystone Pipeline project was halted in 2021 by TC Energy after direct orders from Biden. The project was stopped because environmentalists argued it would negatively affect the climate. At that time, Andy Black, the CEO of the Association of Oil Pipelines, called out Biden’s move and said, “Killing 10,000 jobs and taking $2.2 billion in payroll out of workers’ pockets is not what Americans need or want right now.” (via NPR )
The post Donald Trump’s New AI Photo Includes Tombstone Labeled ‘Buried By Biden’ appeared first on Mandatory .
